Migrated the 12 stragglers to `db.execute({ sql, params })`: `cohort.js`, `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, and `session.js`.

Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` and every `cache.query` call untouched, since those aren't part of the swap. `verify.js` passes clean.
